messages:
lina: quick design nit — noticed the KMS key hover shows the full ARN and it forces audit-log rows to grow on narrow screens. feels messy in the console table.

sam: can you paste a screenshot? I remember this pushing the timestamp column off-screen on mobile. :eyes:

lina: screenshot: https://figma.redwood/proto/keys-compact — but tl;dr: hover popover is wide and the monospace block prevents wrapping, so rows become 2–3 lines.

maria: accessibility note: screen readers will read the whole ARN. we should avoid exposing the full string by default. propose visible: "Key ••••ABCD" + hidden aria-label that says "KMS key ending in ABCD, encrypted". also the copy button needs aria-label.

jon: dev note — current popover markup is a <pre> with the ARN which is why it doesn't wrap. quick fix would be CSS + role changes. example:

```
.kms-popover { max-width: 320px; white-space: normal; word-break: break-word; }
.copy-btn { aria-label: "Copy key"; }
<aside role="dialog" aria-modal="false">…</aside>
```

This will let the popover be narrow on mobile.

sam: +1 on wrapping, but what's the plan for audit log export lines? they need full ARN for SEPs. maybe full ARN only in the export/download or in the detail flyout.

lina: exactly — proposal: table shows masked key + tooltip/popover with truncated preview and a "view full" link that opens the key detail modal (auth gated). export still contains full ARN.

maria: microcopy for the tooltip: "Key ending in ABCD — click to copy or view details". shorter than current copy. also ensure contrast on the copy button, and focus state for keyboard users.

jon: implementation detail: will add a data-attr with last4 so screen reader can get it without reading the full ARN: data-kms-last4="ABCD" and then aria-label="KMS key ending in ABCD". avoids leaking across DOM.

kevin-bot: deploy-checklist: add unit test for popover overflow + axe scan for aria-labels.

sam: one more UX nit — column ordering: when table is narrow we currently show [Retention | Region | Key]. users said they'd prefer Region first, retention as a small badge after the key. thoughts?

lina: i vote Region first (primary filter), key next, retention as badge under the key on mobile. keeps region filter discoverable.

maria: accessibility-wise region is important for context, agree. retention as badge needs accessible name, e.g. aria-label="Retention period: 30 days".

jon: i'll prototype CSS for stacked cells on mobile: region left, then stacked key + retention badge. shouldn't be hard.

sam: sounds good — next steps: jon to submit PR with CSS + aria changes, lina to update figma microcopy and popover artboard, maria will run an a11y pass once PR lands. i'll add kevin-bot checklist items. :thumbsup:

lina: thanks — i'll also change hover copy to the shorter line and add the "view details" CTA. posting new figma link when done.

jon: ETA for PR: end of week.

maria: i'll queue the a11y test for Monday.

sam: cool, closing this thread once PR merges.
